description: This file contains an in-memory implementation of the IMembershipTable interface for testing purposes within the Orleans testing framework. It manages silo membership data, handles gateway retrieval, and provides methods to manipulate and query silo statuses and entries.

classes.name: InProcessMembershipTable
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of IMembershipTable for testing, managing silo membership entries and gateway information.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A nested private class within InProcessMembershipTable that handles the internal storage and management of membership data, including insertion, updating, cleanup, and versioning.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, completing immediately.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes membership entries matching the specified cluster ID.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads the membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry if it doesn't already exist and version matches.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry if the ETag and version match.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAliveTime of a membership entry.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries for silos marked as dead and with IAmAliveTime before a specified date.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider, no-op.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Retrieves active gateway URIs from the membership table.

methods.name: GetSiloStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of a specified silo.
